answer_1.quote: We ask the LLM to generate names for individuals in various professions... We ask the LLMs to generate exactly 10 names for each question.
answer_1.outputs: Names of professionals, multiple-choice opinions on social norms

answer_2.quote: To assess the diversity of LLM responses... we rely on the following entropy measures. Reason and Valence Entropy... Demographic Entropies.

answer_3.quote: To estimate the cultural and geographic origin of names, we used the following prompt: Given the name "{name}", predict... using GPT-4o-mini.

answer_4.quote: We collected human annotations through Prolific... Annotators were given a name and profession... instructed to search the provided name on Google and Wikipedia.
answer_4.guideline: Verify hallucination by checking name-profession association via Google/Wikipedia
